title: Display the file on screen when its uploaded with the help of st.file_uploader widget
body:
### Checklist

- [X] I have searched the [existing issues](https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/issues) for similar feature requests.
- [X] I added a descriptive title and summary to this issue.

### Summary

Thanks for implementing the file_uploader widget, I was really looking forward for that.
Display the file when its uploaded with the help of st.file_uploader widget.
I would like to suggest to add a parameter to st.file_uploader widget.




### Why?

![image](https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/assets/105560839/060741bc-fe91-4a7b-9dbd-a3bfae22414c)

I want to display the file when it has been uploaded using st.file_uploader.

### How?

Add parameter as display_file=true to st.file_uploader widget

### Additional Context

Thanks in advance for considering the changes.

comments.body:
**To help Streamlit prioritize this feature, react with a 👍 (thumbs up emoji) to the initial post.**

Your vote helps us identify which enhancements matter most to our users.

![Views](https://api.views-badge.org/badge/st-issue-7869)

That shouldn't be part of the `st.file_uploader` widget, rather a standalone previewer, imo. There was a discussion somewhere on PDF previewer for Streamlit, images can already be shown.

This might help you currently: https://discuss.streamlit.io/t/using-st-markdown-to-show-embedded-pdf-file-gets-page-not-found/35527/5 in particular - base64 encoding
It would be nice to add parameter to he st.file_uploader widget instead of using another widget.

Two notes:

1) We definitely want to add a built-in PDF viewer, so you can easily build this yourself (please upvote #7235 for that!). 
2) We were thinking about adding some file-specific uploader widgets in the future, e.g. an `st.document_uploader` or an `st.image_uploader`. These would automatically display the uploaded files in a nice way and do a few extra things (e.g. return images as Numpy arrays or PIL files, or automatically extract the text from PDF documents). Let me know if you have thoughts on this!
